inputs.name: cds_jwt_iss
inputs.label: CRD JWT Issuer
inputs.description:
Value of the `iss` claim that will be sent in the JWT used to authorize the client's hook
              request sent as the Bearer token in the `Authorization` header.
              This value will be used to associate incoming requests with this test
              session and any requests that use a different `iss` value will not be recognized.

inputs.name: cds_jwk_set
inputs.label: CRD JSON Web Key Set (JWKS)
inputs.description:
The CRD client's JWK Set containing it's public key. May be either
              a publicly accessible url containing the JWKS, or the raw JWKS.
              The client suite may be run without this input, but it is required
              for the tests to pass.

inputs.name: complete_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Complete Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description:
The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated
              complete prefetch CRD server. This Organization must be referenced as the
              payer on Coverages in hook requests made to services described by the
              `https://inferno.healthit.gov/suites/custom/crd_client_v221/cds-services` discovery endpoint.
              The client suite may be run without this input, but it is required
              for the tests to pass.

inputs.name: subset_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Subset Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description:
The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated
              subset prefetch CRD server. This Organization must be referenced
              payer on Coverages in hook requests made to services described by the
              `https://inferno.healthit.gov/suites/custom/crd_client_v221/prefetch-subset/cds-services` discovery endpoint.
              The client suite may be run without this input, but it is required
              for the tests to pass.

inputs.name: complete_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Complete Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description:
The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated
              complete prefetch CRD server. This Organization must be referenced as the

inputs.name: cds_jwt_iss
inputs.label: CRD JWT Issuer
inputs.description:
Value of the `iss` claim that must be present in the JWT used to authorize the client's hook
              request sent as the Bearer token in the `Authorization` header.
              Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: complete_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Complete Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description:
The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated
              complete prefetch CRD server. This Organization must be referenced as the
              payer on Coverages in hook requests made to services described by the `https://inferno.healthit.gov/suites/custom/crd_client_v221/cds-services`
              discovery endpoint. The client suite may be run without this input, but it is required
              for the tests to pass.
              Re-run the "Registration" group to provide this detail.

inputs.name: subset_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Subset Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description:
The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated
              subset prefetch CRD server. This Organization must be referenced
              payer on Coverages in hook requests made to services described by the
              `https://inferno.healthit.gov/suites/custom/crd_client_v221/prefetch-subset/cds-services` discovery endpoint.
              The client suite may be run without this input, but it is required
              for the tests to pass.
              Re-run the "Registration" group to provide this detail.

inputs.name: cds_jwt_iss
inputs.label: CRD JWT Issuer
inputs.description:
Value of the `iss` claim that must be present in the JWT used to authorize the client's hook
              request sent as the Bearer token in the `Authorization` header.
              Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: cds_jwk_set
inputs.label: CRD JSON Web Key Set (JWKS)
inputs.description:
The client's registered JWK Set, provided during the "Registration" group, containing
            it's public key. Used only when a request was received with a JWT without the `jku`
            header. May be either a publicly accessible url containing the JWKS, or the raw JWKS
            JSON. Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: encounter_start_response_approach
inputs.label: Response generation approach for encounter-start
inputs.description:
Determines how Inferno will generate response for encounter-start
              hook invocations.

inputs.name: encounter_start_selected_response_types
inputs.label: Response types to return from encounter-start hook requests
inputs.description:
Select the CRD response types that the simulated Inferno CRD server will [mock](https://github.com/inferno-framework/davinci-crd-test-kit/wiki/Controlling-Simulated-Responses#mocked-responses)
              when responding to hook invocations. If no types are selected, Inferno will mock and return
              an [Instructions](https://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-crd/2.2.1/en/cards.html#instructions-response-type)
              response for this secondary hook.

inputs.name: encounter_start_custom_response_template
inputs.label: Custom response template for encounter-start hook requests
inputs.description:
Provide a [custom response template](https://github.com/inferno-framework/davinci-crd-test-kit/wiki/Controlling-Simulated-Responses#tester-directed-custom-responses)
              in JSON form for Inferno to use when responding to hook invocations.

inputs.name: cds_jwt_iss
inputs.label: CRD JWT Issuer
inputs.description:
Value of the `iss` claim that must be present in the JWT used to authorize the client's hook
              request sent as the Bearer token in the `Authorization` header.
              Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: order_select_response_approach
inputs.label: Response generation approach for order-select
inputs.description:
Determines how Inferno will generate response for order-select
              hook invocations.

inputs.name: order_select_selected_response_types
inputs.label: Response types to return from order-select hook requests
inputs.description:
Select the CRD response types that the simulated Inferno CRD server will [mock](https://github.com/inferno-framework/davinci-crd-test-kit/wiki/Controlling-Simulated-Responses#mocked-responses)
              when responding to hook invocations. If no types are selected, Inferno will mock and return
              an [Instructions](https://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-crd/2.2.1/en/cards.html#instructions-response-type)
              response for this secondary hook.

inputs.name: order_select_custom_response_template
inputs.label: Custom response template for order-select hook requests
inputs.description:
Provide a [custom response template](https://github.com/inferno-framework/davinci-crd-test-kit/wiki/Controlling-Simulated-Responses#tester-directed-custom-responses)
              in JSON form for Inferno to use when responding to hook invocations.

inputs.name: cds_jwt_iss
inputs.label: CRD JWT Issuer
inputs.description:
Value of the `iss` claim that must be present in the JWT used to authorize the client's hook
              request sent as the Bearer token in the `Authorization` header.
              Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: complete_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Complete Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description:
The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated
              complete prefetch CRD server. This Organization must be referenced as the
              payer on Coverages in hook requests made to services described by the `https://inferno.healthit.gov/suites/custom/crd_client_v221/cds-services`
              discovery endpoint. The client suite may be run without this input, but it is required
              for the tests to pass.
              Re-run the "Registration" group to provide this detail.

inputs.name: subset_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Subset Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description:
The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated
              subset prefetch CRD server. This Organization must be referenced
              payer on Coverages in hook requests made to services described by the
              `https://inferno.healthit.gov/suites/custom/crd_client_v221/prefetch-subset/cds-services` discovery endpoint.
              The client suite may be run without this input, but it is required
              for the tests to pass.
              Re-run the "Registration" group to provide this detail.

inputs.name: cds_jwt_iss
inputs.label: CRD JWT Issuer
inputs.description:
Value of the `iss` claim that must be present in the JWT used to authorize the client's hook
              request sent as the Bearer token in the `Authorization` header.
              Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: cds_jwk_set
inputs.label: CRD JSON Web Key Set (JWKS)
inputs.description:
The client's registered JWK Set, provided during the "Registration" group, containing
            it's public key. Used only when a request was received with a JWT without the `jku`
            header. May be either a publicly accessible url containing the JWKS, or the raw JWKS
            JSON. Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: order_select_response_approach
inputs.label: Response generation approach for order-select
inputs.description:
Determines how Inferno will generate response for order-select
              hook invocations.

inputs.name: order_select_selected_response_types
inputs.label: Response types to return from order-select hook requests
inputs.description:
Select the CRD response types that the simulated Inferno CRD server will [mock](https://github.com/inferno-framework/davinci-crd-test-kit/wiki/Controlling-Simulated-Responses#mocked-responses)
              when responding to hook invocations. If no types are selected, Inferno will mock and return
              an [Instructions](https://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-crd/2.2.1/en/cards.html#instructions-response-type)
              response for this secondary hook.

inputs.description:

              hook invocations.

inputs.name: order_sign_selected_response_types
inputs.label: Response types to return from order-sign hook requests
inputs.description:

              when responding to hook invocations. If no types are selected, Inferno will mock and return
              a [Coverage Information](https://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-crd/2.2.1/en/cards.html#coverage-information-response-type)
              response for this primary hook.

              in JSON form for Inferno to use when responding to hook invocations.

inputs.name: cds_jwt_iss
inputs.label: CRD JWT Issuer
inputs.description:
Value of the `iss` claim that must be present in the JWT used to authorize the client's hook
              request sent as the Bearer token in the `Authorization` header.
              Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: complete_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Complete Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description:
The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated
              complete prefetch CRD server. This Organization must be referenced as the
              payer on Coverages in hook requests made to services described by the `https://inferno.healthit.gov/suites/custom/crd_client_v221/cds-services`
              discovery endpoint. The client suite may be run without this input, but it is required
              for the tests to pass.
              Re-run the "Registration" group to provide this detail.

inputs.name: subset_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Subset Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description:
The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated
              subset prefetch CRD server. This Organization must be referenced
              payer on Coverages in hook requests made to services described by the
              `https://inferno.healthit.gov/suites/custom/crd_client_v221/prefetch-subset/cds-services` discovery endpoint.
              The client suite may be run without this input, but it is required
              for the tests to pass.
              Re-run the "Registration" group to provide this detail.

inputs.name: cds_jwt_iss
inputs.label: CRD JWT Issuer
inputs.description:
Value of the `iss` claim that must be present in the JWT used to authorize the client's hook
              request sent as the Bearer token in the `Authorization` header.
              Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: cds_jwk_set
inputs.label: CRD JSON Web Key Set (JWKS)
inputs.description:
The client's registered JWK Set, provided during the "Registration" group, containing
            it's public key. Used only when a request was received with a JWT without the `jku`
            header. May be either a publicly accessible url containing the JWKS, or the raw JWKS
            JSON. Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: cds_jwt_iss
inputs.label: CRD JWT Issuer
inputs.description:
Value of the `iss` claim that must be present in the JWT used to authorize the client's hook
              request sent as the Bearer token in the `Authorization` header.
              Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: order_dispatch_response_approach
inputs.label: Response generation approach for order-dispatch
inputs.description:
Determines how Inferno will generate response for order-dispatch
              hook invocations.

inputs.name: order_dispatch_selected_response_types
inputs.label: Response types to return from order-dispatch hook requests
inputs.description:
Select the CRD response types that the simulated Inferno CRD server will [mock](https://github.com/inferno-framework/davinci-crd-test-kit/wiki/Controlling-Simulated-Responses#mocked-responses)
              when responding to hook invocations. If no types are selected, Inferno will mock and return
              a [Coverage Information](https://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-crd/2.2.1/en/cards.html#coverage-information-response-type)
              response for this primary hook.

inputs.name: order_dispatch_custom_response_template
inputs.label: Custom response template for order-dispatch hook requests
inputs.description:
Provide a [custom response template](https://github.com/inferno-framework/davinci-crd-test-kit/wiki/Controlling-Simulated-Responses#tester-directed-custom-responses)
              in JSON form for Inferno to use when responding to hook invocations.

inputs.name: cds_jwt_iss
inputs.label: CRD JWT Issuer
inputs.description:
Value of the `iss` claim that must be present in the JWT used to authorize the client's hook
              request sent as the Bearer token in the `Authorization` header.
              Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: complete_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Complete Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description:
The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated
              complete prefetch CRD server. This Organization must be referenced as the
              payer on Coverages in hook requests made to services described by the `https://inferno.healthit.gov/suites/custom/crd_client_v221/cds-services`
              discovery endpoint. The client suite may be run without this input, but it is required
              for the tests to pass.
              Re-run the "Registration" group to provide this detail.

inputs.name: subset_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Subset Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description:
The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated
              subset prefetch CRD server. This Organization must be referenced
              payer on Coverages in hook requests made to services described by the
              `https://inferno.healthit.gov/suites/custom/crd_client_v221/prefetch-subset/cds-services` discovery endpoint.
              The client suite may be run without this input, but it is required
              for the tests to pass.
              Re-run the "Registration" group to provide this detail.

inputs.name: cds_jwt_iss
inputs.label: CRD JWT Issuer

inputs.name: cds_jwk_set
inputs.label: CRD JSON Web Key Set (JWKS)
inputs.description:
The client's registered JWK Set, provided during the "Registration" group, containing
            it's public key. Used only when a request was received with a JWT without the `jku`
            header. May be either a publicly accessible url containing the JWKS, or the raw JWKS
            JSON. Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: order_dispatch_response_approach
inputs.label: Response generation approach for order-dispatch
inputs.description:
Determines how Inferno will generate response for order-dispatch
              hook invocations.

inputs.name: order_dispatch_selected_response_types
inputs.label: Response types to return from order-dispatch hook requests
inputs.description:
Select the CRD response types that the simulated Inferno CRD server will [mock](https://github.com/inferno-framework/davinci-crd-test-kit/wiki/Controlling-Simulated-Responses#mocked-responses)
              when responding to hook invocations. If no types are selected, Inferno will mock and return
              a [Coverage Information](https://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-crd/2.2.1/en/cards.html#coverage-information-response-type)
              response for this primary hook.

inputs.name: order_dispatch_custom_response_template
inputs.label: Custom response template for order-dispatch hook requests
inputs.description:
Provide a [custom response template](https://github.com/inferno-framework/davinci-crd-test-kit/wiki/Controlling-Simulated-Responses#tester-directed-custom-responses)
              in JSON form for Inferno to use when responding to hook invocations.

inputs.name: cds_jwk_set
inputs.label: CRD JSON Web Key Set (JWKS)
inputs.description:
The client's registered JWK Set, provided during the "Registration" group, containing
            it's public key. Used only when a request was received with a JWT without the `jku`
            header. May be either a publicly accessible url containing the JWKS, or the raw JWKS
            JSON. Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

Select the CRD response types that the simulated Inferno CRD server will [mock](https://github.com/inferno-framework/davinci-crd-test-kit/wiki/Controlling-Simulated-Responses#mocked-responses)
              when responding to hook invocations. If no types are selected, Inferno will mock and return
              a [Coverage Information](https://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-crd/2.2.1/en/cards.html#coverage-information-response-type)
              response.

inputs.name: cds_jwt_iss
inputs.label: CRD JWT Issuer
inputs.description:
Value of the `iss` claim that must be present in the JWT used to authorize the client's hook
              request sent as the Bearer token in the `Authorization` header.
              Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.

inputs.name: complete_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Complete Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description:
The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated
              complete prefetch CRD server. This Organization must be referenced as the
              payer on Coverages in hook requests made to services described by the `https://inferno.healthit.gov/suites/custom/crd_client_v221/cds-services`
              discovery endpoint. The client suite may be run without this input, but it is required
              for the tests to pass.
              Re-run the "Registration" group to provide this detail.

inputs.name: subset_prefetch_service_organization_id
inputs.label: Subset Prefetch Service Organization id
inputs.description:
The FHIR Organization id associated with Inferno's simulated
              subset prefetch CRD server. This Organization must be referenced
              payer on Coverages in hook requests made to services described by the
              `https://inferno.healthit.gov/suites/custom/crd_client_v221/prefetch-subset/cds-services` discovery endpoint.
              The client suite may be run without this input, but it is required
              for the tests to pass.
              Re-run the "Registration" group to provide this detail.

inputs.name: cds_jwk_set
inputs.label: CRD JSON Web Key Set (JWKS)
inputs.description:
The client's registered JWK Set, provided during the "Registration" group, containing
            it's public key. Used only when a request was received with a JWT without the `jku`
            header. May be either a publicly accessible url containing the JWKS, or the raw JWKS
            JSON. Run or re-run the "Registration" group to set or change this value.
